cards.imageAlt: Refuel，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从上述图中看到了什么？
cards.referenceText: From the picture I can see there is an aircraft parking on the ground. The airplane has two propellers. Beside the plane, there is a fuel truck, so I guess the plane is getting ready to refuel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从图中我可以看到有一架飞机停在地面，飞机有2个螺旋桨。在飞机的旁边，有一辆加油车，因此，我猜测，飞机正在准备加油。

cards.audioText: How many fuel tanks are there on your aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的飞机上有几个油箱？
cards.referenceText:
I fly C172, we only have one fuel tank.
But as far as I know, some big aircraft, like B737, they have three tanks.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我飞的是塞斯纳172机型，我们的飞机上只有一个油箱。
但是据我所知，一些大飞机，如波音737，有3个油箱。

cards.audioTextZh: 哪些情况会造成燃油污染？
cards.referenceText:
I have never encountered fuel contamination.
But as far as I know, if we refuel in bad weather conditions, such as sandstorms, rain and so on, there will be the possibility of fuel contamination.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我从未遇到过燃油污染的情况。
但是据我所知，如果我们在恶劣的天气条件下加油，比如沙尘暴，降雨等，就会有燃油污染的可能性。
